method: Accelerated production simulation at fixed 1/60 second; 3 laps, 900 second limit, real rival AI/combat; player autopilot with periodic fire/weapon cycling. Garage vehicle specs with controlled mixed weapon loadout. Pit adapter supplies resources, excluding economy. Invariants sampled once per second.
limitations: Not a browser FPS benchmark or real-time endurance test.
Career scenarios are independent races, not a persisted ten-event championship.
Practice permits normal disable recovery and autopilot re-engagement.
Not human balance acceptance; career runs use simple autopilot and no strategic pit stops.
